MaterialCraft app icon (materialcraft.svg, materialcraft-small.svg and every file derived from them in
this directory: materialcraft-1024.png, materialcraft.icns, materialcraft.ico, hicolor/).

third-party material). Licensed like the rest of MaterialCraft, under either of

at your option.

Regenerate the derived files with packaging/icons.sh.
